descriptions.id:
The all-in-one women's health tracker that reveals hidden patterns other apps miss.

Track your cycle, manage PCOS or endometriosis, try to conceive, navigate pregnancy and postpartum, or make sense of perimenopause. Wove connects all of it to show you the why behind how you feel.

DISCOVER YOUR BODY'S HIDDEN PATTERNS

Track your complete hormone story:
- Period tracker with fertility calendar & ovulation calculator
- Menstrual cycle predictions & hormone phase insights
- PMS & PMDD symptom tracking
- PCOS, endometriosis & hormonal health management
- Fertility tracking for TTC: IVF, IUI, FET & egg freezing
- Pregnancy tracker with kick counter & contraction timer
- Postpartum recovery, breastfeeding & baby tracking
- Perimenopause & menopause tracking, including hot flashes
- Lab tracking: log TSH, AMH, progesterone & more over time

Connect your cycle to everything else. See how your hormones affect:
- Workout performance & recovery
- Mood, stress & anxiety levels
- Cravings, appetite & nutrition
- Sleep quality & energy patterns
- Brain fog & concentration

TEST YOUR OWN THEORIES

Think dairy breaks you out? Save it as a Health Clue and the app checks it against your real data over time. Validated or busted, you'll know.

YOUR QUARTERLY HEALTH WRAPPED

Every quarter, your Health Wrapped: physical, mental, sleep & hormonal health scored and summed up. See the whole picture, not just one metric.

ONE APP REPLACES YOUR ENTIRE COLLECTION

Stop juggling:
- Period & ovulation trackers
- Fertility & pregnancy apps
- Fitness & workout logs
- Symptom & mood diaries
- Habit & wellness trackers

Auto-syncs with Apple Watch, Oura Ring, Garmin & Apple Health. Glucose data flows in too, from Dexcom & Libre. Log by voice from your phone or your Apple Watch, and scan nutrition barcodes.

PERFECT FOR:
- Cycle syncing your lifestyle, workouts & nutrition
- Fertility tracking & trying to conceive (TTC)
- PCOS, PMDD & endometriosis management
- Hormone health & hormonal acne
- Preparing data-driven health reports for doctor visits

ALSO IDEAL FOR:
- Tracking mysterious symptoms without clear patterns
- Irregular or missing periods
- Anyone who feels "off" but doesn't know why
- Understanding energy & mood beyond just periods

CORE FEATURES - FREE:
- Menstrual cycle tracker & period calendar
- Ovulation calculator & fertility window predictions
- Symptom, mood & energy logging
- Basic pattern insights & correlations
- Fitness, nutrition & habit tracking
- Apple Health & wearable device sync
- Pregnancy tracker & kick counter

WOVE PRO - ADVANCED INSIGHTS:
- Unlimited habit & symptom tracking
- Extended pattern analysis (12+ months)
- Detailed hormone phase breakdowns
- Ask Wove: AI answers based on your own history
- Export health reports for doctor visits
- Priority support & early access to features

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT

No ads. No selling your data. Export or delete it anytime.

Subscription pricing and terms:
Wove offers a free version with core tracking features. Wove Pro is available as an auto-renewing monthly subscription for $9.99 USD/month.

Payment will be charged to your iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase. Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage your subscriptions and turn off auto-renewal by going to your Account Settings after purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Created by women who understand that tracking your period is just the beginning. Understanding your patterns changes everything.

Stop wondering why you feel the way you do. Download Wove and see what your body's been telling you.

descriptions.es-MX:
El rastreador de salud femenina todo en uno que revela los patrones ocultos que otras apps dejan pasar.

Sigue tu ciclo, maneja el SOP o la endometriosis, busca embarazo, vive tu embarazo y tu posparto, o entiende lo que cambia en la perimenopausia. Wove conecta todo eso para mostrarte el porqué de cómo te sientes.

DESCUBRE LOS PATRONES OCULTOS DE TU CUERPO

Toda tu historia hormonal:
- Calendario de regla con ventana fértil y calculadora de ovulación
- Predicciones del ciclo menstrual y lectura de las fases hormonales
- Registro de síntomas de SPM y TDPM
- Manejo de SOP, endometriosis y salud hormonal
- Fertilidad para buscar embarazo: FIV, IIU, transferencia y congelación de óvulos
- Seguimiento de embarazo con contador de patadas y cronómetro de contracciones
- Recuperación posparto, lactancia y seguimiento del bebé
- Perimenopausia y menopausia, incluidos los bochornos
- Laboratorio: registra TSH, AMH, progesterona y más a lo largo del tiempo

Mira cómo influyen tus hormonas en:
- Rendimiento y recuperación
- Ánimo, estrés y ansiedad
- Antojos, apetito y alimentación
- Calidad de sueño y energía
- Concentración y niebla mental

PON A PRUEBA TUS PROPIAS TEORÍAS

¿Los lácteos te sacan granitos? Guárdalo como Pista de salud y la app lo revisa con tus datos reales con el tiempo. Confirmado o descartado, lo vas a saber.

TU RESUMEN TRIMESTRAL

Cada trimestre, tu Health Wrapped: salud física, mental, sueño y hormonas, con puntaje y resumen. El panorama completo, no una sola cifra.

UNA APP REEMPLAZA TODA TU COLECCIÓN

Deja de hacer malabares con:
- Apps de regla y ovulación
- Apps de fertilidad y embarazo
- Registros de entrenamiento
- Diarios de síntomas y de ánimo
- Rastreadores de hábitos y bienestar

Se sincroniza sola con Apple Watch, Oura Ring, Garmin y Salud de Apple, más la glucosa de Dexcom y Libre. Registra por voz desde tu teléfono o tu Apple Watch y escanea códigos de barras.

IDEAL PARA:
- Adaptar tu vida, tus entrenamientos y tu alimentación a tu ciclo
- Seguimiento de fertilidad y búsqueda de embarazo
- Manejo de SOP, TDPM y endometriosis
- Salud hormonal y acné hormonal
- Tener síntomas sin un patrón claro
- Una regla irregular o que no llega
- Sentirte rara y no saber por qué
- Entender tu energía y tu ánimo más allá de la regla
- Preparar reportes con datos para tus citas médicas

FUNCIONES BÁSICAS, GRATIS:
- Rastreador de ciclo menstrual y calendario de regla
- Calculadora de ovulación y predicción de días fértiles
- Registro de síntomas, ánimo y energía
- Primeros patrones y correlaciones
- Ejercicio, nutrición y hábitos
- Sincronización con Salud de Apple y wearables
- Seguimiento de embarazo y contador de patadas

WOVE PRO, MÁS PROFUNDIDAD:
- Hábitos y síntomas ilimitados
- Análisis de patrones extendido (más de 12 meses)
- Fases hormonales a detalle
- Pregúntale a Wove: respuestas basadas en tu propio historial
- Exporta reportes de salud para tus citas médicas
- Soporte prioritario y acceso anticipado a novedades

PRIVADO DESDE EL INICIO

Sin anuncios. No vendemos tus datos. Expórtalos o bórralos cuando quieras.

Suscripción, precio y condiciones:
Wove tiene una versión gratuita con las funciones básicas de registro. Wove Pro es una suscripción mensual de renovación automática por 9.99 USD al mes.

El pago se cargará a tu cuenta de iTunes al confirmar la compra. La suscripción se renueva automáticamente a menos que desactives la renovación al menos 24 horas antes de que termine el periodo en curso, y el cargo se hace dentro de esas 24 horas. Administra tus suscripciones y la renovación automática en los ajustes de tu cuenta después de la compra.

Creada por mujeres que saben que registrar tu regla es apenas el principio. Entender tus patrones lo cambia todo.

Deja de preguntarte por qué te sientes así. Descarga Wove y mira lo que tu cuerpo lleva tiempo diciéndote.

Verfolge deinen Zyklus, komm mit PCOS oder Endometriose klar, werde schwanger, begleite Schwangerschaft und Wochenbett oder verstehe deine Wechseljahre. Wove verbindet alles und zeigt dir das Warum hinter deinem Befinden.

VERSTECKTE MUSTER DEINES KÖRPERS ENTDECKEN

Deine ganze Hormongeschichte:
- Periodentracker mit Fruchtbarkeitskalender und Eisprungrechner
- Zyklusprognosen und Einblicke in die Hormonphasen
- PMS- und PMDS-Symptome erfassen
- PCOS, Endometriose und Hormongesundheit im Blick
- Kinderwunsch und Fruchtbarkeit: IVF, IUI, Kryotransfer und Social Freezing
- Schwangerschaftstracker mit Kindsbewegungs- und Wehenzähler
- Rückbildung, Stillen und Baby-Tracking
- Perimenopause und Wechseljahre, inklusive Hitzewallungen
- Laborwerte: TSH, AMH, Progesteron und mehr über die Zeit

Sieh, wie deine Hormone wirken auf:
- Training und Regeneration
- Stimmung, Stress und Anspannung
- Heißhunger, Appetit und Ernährung
- Schlafqualität und Energie
- Konzentration und Gehirnnebel

TESTE DEINE EIGENEN THEORIEN

Milchprodukte machen dir Pickel? Speichere es als Health Clue: Die App prüft es über die Zeit an deinen echten Daten. Bestätigt oder widerlegt, du wirst es wissen.

DEIN QUARTALS-WRAPPED

Jedes Quartal dein Health Wrapped: Körper, Kopf, Schlaf und Hormone bewertet und zusammengefasst. Das ganze Bild statt einer einzelnen Zahl.

EINE APP ERSETZT DEINE GANZE SAMMLUNG

Schluss mit dem Jonglieren:
- Perioden- und Eisprung-Apps
- Kinderwunsch- und Schwangerschafts-Apps
- Trainings- und Workout-Logs
- Symptom- und Stimmungstagebücher
- Gewohnheits- und Wellness-Tracker

Synchronisiert automatisch mit Apple Watch, Oura Ring, Garmin und Apple Health, dazu Glukose von Dexcom und Libre. Logge per Sprache vom iPhone oder der Apple Watch und scanne Nährwert-Barcodes.

PASST GUT, WENN DU:
- Lebensstil, Training und Ernährung am Zyklus ausrichtest
- Fruchtbarkeit trackst und schwanger werden möchtest
- PCOS, PMDS oder Endometriose managst
- Hormongesundheit und hormonelle Akne verstehen willst
- eine unregelmäßige Periode hast oder sie ausbleibt
- Symptome ohne erkennbares Muster hast
- dich daneben fühlst und nicht weißt, warum
- Energie und Stimmung jenseits der Periode verstehen willst
- Zahlen für den Arzttermin vorbereitest

KOSTENLOSE KERNFUNKTIONEN:
- Zyklustracker und Periodenkalender
- Eisprungrechner und fruchtbare Tage
- Symptome, Stimmung und Energie erfassen
- Erste Musteranalysen und Zusammenhänge
- Sport, Ernährung und Gewohnheiten
- Apple Health und Wearable-Sync
- Schwangerschaftstracker und Kindsbewegungszähler

WOVE PRO, MEHR TIEFE:
- Unbegrenzt Gewohnheiten und Symptome tracken
- Erweiterte Musteranalyse (über 12 Monate)
- Detaillierte Hormonphasen
- Frag Wove: Antworten aus deiner eigenen Historie
- Gesundheitsberichte für den Arzttermin exportieren
- Priorisierter Support und früher Zugang zu Neuem

PRIVAT VON HAUS AUS

Keine Werbung. Kein Verkauf deiner Daten. Export oder Löschung jederzeit.

Abo, Preis und Bedingungen:
Wove bietet eine kostenlose Version mit den zentralen Tracking-Funktionen. Wove Pro ist ein automatisch verlängerndes Monatsabo für 9,99 USD pro Monat.

Das Abo verlängert sich automatisch, sofern du die Verlängerung nicht mindestens 24 Stunden vor Ende der laufenden Periode deaktivierst; abgebucht wird innerhalb dieser 24 Stunden. Abos und die automatische Verlängerung verwaltest du nach dem Kauf in deinen Account-Einstellungen.

Gemacht von Frauen, die wissen, dass die Periode zu tracken erst der Anfang ist. Deine Muster zu verstehen verändert alles.

Hör auf, dich zu fragen, warum du dich so fühlst. Lade Wove und sieh, was dein Körper dir längst sagt.

descriptions.en-US:
Your labs came back normal. So why do you still feel like this?

Wove is the women's health tracker that investigates. It brings your cycle, sleep, food, symptoms, labs and wearable data together, notices the patterns you can't see, and helps you test what's really driving how you feel.

Then you walk into your next appointment with more than a feeling.

HOW IT WORKS
- Gather: say how you feel in one sentence and Wove logs it. Apple Watch and Oura fill in sleep, heart rate and activity on their own.
- Notice: Wove checks your symptoms against your sleep, cycle phase, food, stress and weather, including effects that show up a day or two later.
- Explain: each pattern comes with a simple explanation of what may be going on in your body.
- Test: turn a hunch into a Health Clue, then run an Experiment with a real baseline. You get an honest verdict, including "not enough to tell yet".
- Share: export your Case File, a PDF with your history, patterns, labs and the questions worth asking, and bring it to your doctor.

Wove shows patterns, never a diagnosis. It helps you prepare for your doctor, never replaces one.

BUILT FOR
- Symptoms nobody has explained: fatigue, poor sleep, bloating, mood that swings with your cycle, pain, migraines
- PCOS: irregular and missing cycles, labs and glucose beside your symptoms
- Perimenopause: hot flashes, sleep and mood as your cycle shifts
- PMDD: daily ratings across cycles, a record you can bring to your doctor
- Endometriosis: pain by type and cycle phase, with gut symptoms and food alongside
- Postpartum: tired, foggy or losing hair months after birth, with your sleep and returning cycle side by side
- Also: thyroid, fibroids, adenomyosis, IBD and autoimmune conditions

ONE RECORD FOR EVERY STAGE
Your history doesn't reset when life does. Trying to conceive, IVF, egg freezing, pregnancy and postpartum all live on the same record as your cycles and symptoms, so you never start from zero.

WORKS WITH
- Apple Health and Apple Watch
- A direct connection to your Oura Ring
- Garmin, Dexcom, Libre and anything else that writes to Apple Health lands in Wove too
- Lab PDFs: import your results and see them next to your symptoms

WOVE PRO
Deeper pattern analysis, Experiments, the Case File export and Wove, your assistant that answers from your own history.

PRIVATE BY DEFAULT
No ads. No selling your data. Export or delete it anytime.

SUBSCRIPTION TERMS
Wove Pro is $9.99 USD/month or $49.99 USD/year. Prices vary by country. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel in your App Store account settings.

descriptions.en-CA:
Your labs came back normal. So why do you still feel like this?

Wove is the women's health tracker that investigates. It brings your cycle, sleep, food, symptoms, labs and wearable data together, notices the patterns you can't see, and helps you test what's really driving how you feel.

Then you walk into your next appointment with more than a feeling.

HOW IT WORKS
- Gather: say how you feel in one sentence and Wove logs it. Apple Watch and Oura fill in sleep, heart rate and activity on their own.
- Notice: Wove checks your symptoms against your sleep, cycle phase, food, stress and weather, including effects that show up a day or two later.
- Explain: each pattern comes with a simple explanation of what may be going on in your body.
- Test: turn a hunch into a Health Clue, then run an Experiment with a real baseline. You get an honest verdict, including "not enough to tell yet".
- Share: export your Case File, a PDF with your history, patterns, labs and the questions worth asking, and bring it to your doctor.

Wove shows patterns, never a diagnosis. It helps you prepare for your doctor, never replaces one.

BUILT FOR
- Symptoms nobody has explained: fatigue, poor sleep, bloating, mood that swings with your cycle, pain, migraines
- PCOS: irregular and missing cycles, labs and glucose beside your symptoms
- Perimenopause: hot flashes, sleep and mood as your cycle shifts
- PMDD: daily ratings across cycles, a record you can bring to your doctor
- Endometriosis: pain by type and cycle phase, with gut symptoms and food alongside
- Postpartum: tired, foggy or losing hair months after birth, with your sleep and returning cycle side by side
- Also: thyroid, fibroids, adenomyosis, IBD and autoimmune conditions

ONE RECORD FOR EVERY STAGE
Your history doesn't reset when life does. Trying to conceive, IVF, egg freezing, pregnancy and postpartum all live on the same record as your cycles and symptoms, so you never start from zero.

WORKS WITH
- Apple Health and Apple Watch
- A direct connection to your Oura Ring
- Garmin, Dexcom, Libre and anything else that writes to Apple Health lands in Wove too
- Lab PDFs: import your results and see them next to your symptoms

Deeper pattern analysis, Experiments, the Case File export and Wove, your assistant that answers from your own history.
